content.english: Adonai’s utterances are perfect utterances;
Those who walk in their path receive a complete reward.
Those who pursue them love the soul’s pleasure,
Inheriting joy and spiritual perfection.

content.hebrew: מִי יְמַלֵּל סוֹד מִצְוֹת, בִּימִין אֵל רְשׁוּמוֹת?
content.transliteration: Mi yemallel sod mitsvot, bimin El reshumot?
content.english: Who can tell of the mystery of the commandments, which are inscribed by God’s right hand?
They bring life to low spirits and dry bones,
They are consolation to anguished and greatly troubled hearts.
The instruction for the leper’s purification, after death:

content.hebrew: תְּרוּפָתוֹ בְּמִין נָקֵל, וְלֹא גָבִישׁ וְרָאמוֹת.
content.transliteration: Terufato bemin naḳel, velo ḡavish veramot.
content.english: His healing is through species that are easy [to acquire], not gavish and ramoth.
content.comments: Gavish and ramoth. Names of precious stones.

content.hebrew: רְאוֹתוֹ מִין יְמִירֵֽהוּ לְדַל בְּתוֹרִים – וְיֵחָשֵׁב כִּשְׂדֵי תְרוּמוֹת.
content.transliteration: Re’oto min yemirehu ledal betorim – veyeḥashev kisdē terumot.
content.english: [God] saw fitting to exchange the species with turtledoves for the poor—it will be considered as if [it were] fields of teruma.
content.comments: Teruma. The portion given to a priest.

content.english: And in order to awaken the foolish to consider their scheming ways,

content.hebrew: שָׂם אֹתוֹת לְבָתִּים, יְרַקְרַקּוֹת אוֹ אֲדַמְדַּמּוֹת.
content.transliteration: Sam otot levattim, yeraḳraḳḳot o adamdammot.
content.english: He placed signs in [their] houses, greenish or reddish.
And through the zav and zava, hidden things become manifest.
content.comments: Zav and zava. A man and a woman, respectively, with certain abnormal genital secretions.

content.english: Happy are those who inherit [the Torah’s commandments], for they have inherited perfection;
In their left hand is beauty, and in their right is sweetness.
It is incumbent upon us to praise Him, in trembling and awe,
For He has distinguished us from all the nations of the earth.
He is the shield for our rescue, who has pulled us out of the depths.
Let us declare His formidability and His holiness, like the angels on high,
Cong. With pure speech and sweetness.

content.hebrew: חזן: וְנֹאמַר: יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֖א רָ֣ם וְנִשָּׂ֑א וְשׁוּלָ֖יו מְלֵאִ֥ים אֶת־הַהֵיכָֽל: שְׂרָפִ֨ים עֹֽמְדִ֤ים ׀ מִמַּ֙עַל֙ ל֔וֹ שֵׁ֧שׁ כְּנָפַ֛יִם שֵׁ֥שׁ כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאֶחָ֑ד בִּשְׁתַּ֣יִם ׀ יְכַסֶּ֣ה פָנָ֗יו וּבִשְׁתַּ֛יִם יְכַסֶּ֥ה רַגְלָ֖יו וּבִשְׁתַּ֥יִם יְעוֹפֵֽף: וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Venomar: Yoshev ‘al kissē ram venissa veshulav mele’im et hahekhal: Serafim omedim, mimma‘al lo shesh kenafayim shesh kenafayim le’eḥad bishtayim, yekhassē fanav uvishtayim yekhassē raḡlav uvishtayim ye‘ofef: Veḳara zē el zē ve’amar
content.english: Cantor. And let us say: [He is] seated on a throne, high and lofty, with His coattails filling the Temple. Seraphim were standing above Him, each one with six wings; with two [wings] they would cover their faces, and with two they would cover their legs, and with two they would fly. And they would call out, this one to that one, and say:

content.hebrew: קהל: קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יו֥י צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ḳadosh, Ḳadosh Ḳadosh Adonai tseva’ot melo khol ha’arets kevodo:
content.english: Congregation: Holy, holy, holy is Adonai Ẓeva’oth; the entire world is full of His Glory. (Isa. 6:1–3)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “Lord of Hosts.”
